title: HOW EPIDEMIC PSYCHOLOGY WORKS ON TWITTER: EVOLUTION OF RESPONSES TO THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC IN THE U.S.
reasoning: The paper empirically tests a sociological model that includes an 'epidemic of moralization' as a core component. The authors specifically operationalize and measure moral foundations (using the Moral Foundation Lexicon) and religious expressions in Twitter data to analyze the psychological response to the COVID-19 pandemic.
